actions.cancel_post.description: Cancel a queued scheduled post before it publishes
actions.cancel_post.props.postId.descrip: The letmepost post id of the queued post (from the Post IDs of a publish, or List Posts).
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_account.props.accountId.desc: The connected account. You can also map an account id from List Accounts.
actions.get_post.description: Retrieve a single post and its publish attempts
actions.get_post.props.postId.descriptio: The letmepost post id: a Post IDs entry from Publish a Post (or Publish or Schedule a Post), or an id from List Posts. The batch id of a publish does not work here.
actions.list_accounts.description: List the social accounts connected to your organization
actions.list_accounts.props.platform.des: Only list accounts on these platforms. Leave empty for all platforms.
actions.list_accounts.props.profileId.de: Only list accounts in this profile. Leave empty for all accounts.
actions.list_media.description: List previously uploaded media assets, newest first
actions.list_media.props.limit.descripti: Maximum number of media assets to return (1 to 500). Larger values return 500.
actions.list_media.props.profileId.descr: Only list media in this profile. Leave empty for all media.
actions.list_pinterest_boards.descriptio: List the boards of a connected Pinterest account
actions.list_pinterest_boards.props.acco: The connected Pinterest account. You can also map an account id from List Accounts.
actions.list_posts.description: Search the post log with filters, newest first
actions.list_posts.props.after.descripti: Only posts created after this time.
actions.list_posts.props.before.descript: Only posts created before this time.
actions.list_posts.props.cursor.descript: The Next Cursor value from a previous List Posts run, to get the next page. Keep the other filters the same.
actions.list_posts.props.errorCode.descr: Only failed posts with this error code, for example platform_rejected. Separate several codes with commas.
actions.list_posts.props.platform.descri: Only posts on these platforms. Leave empty for all.
actions.list_posts.props.q.description: Case-insensitive text to find in the post body (up to 200 characters).
actions.list_posts.props.status.descript: Only posts in these states. Leave empty for all.
actions.publish_post.description: Publish or schedule a post to one or more connected accounts
actions.publish_post.props.accounts.desc: The connected accounts to publish to
Posted as the first comment under the published post, where the platform supports it. Not allowed on scheduled posts.
actions.publish_post.props.idempotencyKe: Reusing the same key never publishes twice, which makes retries safe (up to 128 characters, remembered for 24 hours).
actions.publish_post.props.media.descrip: Media attachments. Give each item a public URL or an existing letmepost media ID, not both.
actions.publish_post.props.pinterestBoar: Board to pin to on Pinterest accounts. Leave empty to use the account default board. Find ids with List Pinterest Boards.
actions.publish_post.props.pinterestCove: Cover image for video pins. Applied to Pinterest accounts only.
actions.publish_post.props.pinterestDest: Outbound link attached to the pin. Applied to Pinterest accounts only.
actions.publish_post.props.pinterestTitl: Title of the pin. Applied to Pinterest accounts only.
actions.publish_post.props.profileId.des: Optional profile to attribute this post to.
actions.publish_post.props.publishNow.de: Publish immediately. Turn off to schedule for a future time with Schedule at.
actions.publish_post.props.scheduledAt.d: When to publish the post (ISO 8601). Used only when Publish now is off; the step fails if both are set.
actions.publish_post.props.text.descript: The post body. Optional when the post is media-only on platforms that allow it.
actions.publish_post_ai.description: Publish a post now, or schedule it, on one or more connected accounts
actions.publish_post_ai.props.accountIds: letmepost account ids (UUIDs) from List Accounts, one per account to publish to. At most 25.
actions.publish_post_ai.props.firstComme: Posted as the first comment under the published post where the platform supports it. Not allowed on scheduled posts.
actions.publish_post_ai.props.idempotenc: Any unique string up to 128 characters. Reusing it within 24 hours returns the first result instead of publishing again.
actions.publish_post_ai.props.media.desc: Media attachments. Give each item a public URL or an existing letmepost media ID, not both.
actions.publish_post_ai.props.pinterestB: Pinterest accounts only: board to pin to, from List Pinterest Boards. Empty uses the account default board.
actions.publish_post_ai.props.pinterestC: Pinterest accounts only: cover image for video pins.
actions.publish_post_ai.props.pinterestD: Pinterest accounts only: outbound link attached to the pin.
actions.publish_post_ai.props.pinterestT: Pinterest accounts only: title of the pin.
Optional profile (UUID) to attribute this post to.
actions.publish_post_ai.props.scheduledA: Future time to publish at, in ISO 8601 with a timezone, e.g. 2026-11-07T09:00:00Z or 2026-11-07T11:00:00+02:00. Leave empty to publish now. Any other format fails without publishing.
actions.publish_post_ai.props.text.descr: The post body. Optional only for media-only posts on platforms that allow them.
actions.reply_to_post.description: Publish a reply under an existing post on X, Threads or Bluesky

actions.reply_to_post.props.idempotencyK: Reusing the same key never publishes twice, which makes retries safe (up to 128 characters, remembered for 24 hours).
actions.reply_to_post.props.media.descri: Media attachments. Give each item a public URL or an existing letmepost media ID, not both.
actions.reply_to_post.props.replyRootCid: Bluesky accounts, optional: CID of the first post of the thread. Give it together with the root URI.

actions.reply_to_post.props.replyToThrea: Threads accounts: id of the Threads post to reply to.

actions.reply_to_post.props.replyToUri.d: Bluesky accounts: at:// URI of the post to reply to (results uri of a publish).
actions.reschedule_post.description: Move a queued scheduled post to a new time
actions.reschedule_post.props.postId.des: The letmepost post id of the queued post (from the Post IDs of a publish, or List Posts).
actions.reschedule_post.props.scheduledA: When the post should publish instead (must be in the future).
actions.upload_media.description: Upload an image or video to letmepost to reuse in posts
actions.upload_media.props.file.descript: The image or video to upload. The type is detected from the file contents.
actions.upload_media.props.profileId.des: Place the upload under this profile. Leave empty with a profile-scoped API key.
